summary: Parts disappeared from Work Order S2-7450 after approval
reported_issue: On WO S2-7450 (Foothills Group), lines 1-3 were approved but the parts on lines 2 and 3 vanished from the order after approval; request to investigate why lines were cleared post-approval and whether data can be restored.
expected_after_fix: Parts attached to work-order lines should not be cleared/deleted when a line is approved.
steps_i_followed: Note: S2-7450 is a specific historical production incident/investigation; that exact WO is not present on staging, so I re-tested the general regression it implies (parts vanishing after approval)
Used WO S9-24938 whose lines carry part_requests (Gear oil; Brake pot; Misc hardware/fittings)
Approved / advanced the lines (Approve action, then bulk status change to Authorized)
Re-read the lines via UI and via GET /api/work-orders/lines/<id> to confirm parts still attached
actual_now: After approval/authorization the parts remained attached to their lines. UI showed both approved lines still listing their parts (Gear oil under line 1; Brake pot + Misc hardware under line 2, all 'Requested'). The API confirmed line 'Service - Steer hub oil' (status=authorized) still carries part_request 'Gear oil'. No parts were cleared by the approval action.
notes: The specific S2-7450 incident is a historical production data investigation and is not reproducible on staging. The general regression (parts disappearing after line approval) does NOT reproduce: parts persist across Approve/Authorize on WO S9-24938 (verified in UI and API). Confidence medium because only the general behavior, not the exact incident, could be exercised.
